tools.name: lookup_word
tools.description: Look up one Chinese word from the HSK 3.0 syllabus: pinyin, level, part of speech, English meaning, an example sentence, and how its level changed from HSK 2.0. Use when the user asks what a word means or which HSK level it is.

tools.name: search_words
tools.description: Search HSK 3.0 words by level, topic tag, or pinyin (with or without tone marks or tone numbers). Returns at most 20 short matches per page. Give at least one of level, topic or pinyin.

tools.name: get_character
tools.description: Get one Chinese character: pinyin, radical, stroke count, components (when known), its HSK character and writing levels, and common HSK words that use it. Includes a link to a stroke-order animation page when one exists.

tools.name: hsk_level_wordlist
tools.description: List the words of one HSK 3.0 level in syllabus order, 50 per page, with pinyin and a short English meaning. Use for study lists; for the full list point the user to the download link.

tools.name: compare_hsk2_hsk3
tools.description: Explain how a word or a whole level changed between the HSK 2.0 and HSK 3.0 syllabi: new, moved up, moved down, unchanged, or dropped, with counts for a level. Give either word or level.

tools.name: practice_quiz
tools.description: Create a short HSK vocabulary quiz (1-10 multiple-choice questions) for a level: meaning, pinyin, fill-in-the-blank, or mixed. Answers are not included; show the questions to the user, collect their choices, then call grade_answers with the quiz_id.

tools.name: grade_answers
tools.description: Grade a quiz created by practice_quiz. Returns which answers were right, the correct option, and a one-line explanation per question. This is practice feedback, not an exam score.

tools.name: exam_dates
tools.description: List upcoming HSK test dates with registration deadlines and result dates, each with a link to its source notice. Dates can change; tell the user to confirm with their test center.
